purpose: Prove at runtime that the authoritative native still path preserves scene HDR values until the filmic display transform and explicitly terminates the Built-in image-effect chain in LDR before PNG evidence is sealed.

forbiddenDefectMasking: local contrast used to hide material errors

failurePolicy.missingImageEffectTransformsToLDR: FAIL native review packet before capture
failurePolicy.nonHdrObservedSource: FAIL native review packet; highlight preservation is not proven
failurePolicy.hdrObservedDestination: FAIL native review packet; HDR-to-LDR termination is not proven
failurePolicy.missingTonemapInvocation: FAIL native review packet; do not seal or score stills
failurePolicy.fallbackInvocation: FAIL native review packet; do not seal or score stills

rationale: The benchmark uses physically plausible sunlight, specular response and a filmic shoulder, so clipping scene values before the display transform would invalidate lighting/material judgments even if the final PNG looks superficially acceptable.
ImageEffectTransformsToLDR makes the intended transition explicit to Unity's Built-in image-effect pipeline instead of relying on an implicit destination format.
Runtime telemetry proves execution and buffer class only. It cannot clear clipping, exposure, color, material, reflection or other visible defects without the actual 3840x2160 frames and 100% crops.

researchReferences.title: Unity ImageEffectTransformsToLDR Scripting API
researchReferences.use: Attribute requests an LDR destination and places subsequent image effects in LDR; the effect is responsible for LDR-range output.

researchReferences.title: Unity 6 Built-in Render Pipeline HDR
researchReferences.use: Forward Built-in HDR requires a camera post-processing effect so the scene can render through an HDR buffer before display conversion.

researchReferences.title: Unity 6 Camera.OnRenderImage
researchReferences.use: Built-in pipeline invokes OnRenderImage after camera rendering for fullscreen image effects.
